title: Infusion Contract Fee — Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing) Observation and Emergency Accounts
content:
| Payer class | Infusion (code 96365 under revenue code 0260) rate per counted unit |
|---|---|
| Commercial HMO Claim | 210.00 USD |
| Commercial PPO Claim | 236.00 USD |
| otherwise (a Marketplace Exchange Plan Claim) | its charges per counted unit times the expected allowed percentage |

This contract fee applies to the infusion on an observation or emergency account of the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) valued for an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing). The infusion is valued at its counted units times that rate, never above its charges, its counted units being its billed units, or one when it is billed with charges but no units.

Hypothetical: 2 units on a Commercial PPO Claim, charges 900.00 → 472.00; charges 400.00 → 400.00.
